notes:
What's new in this update:
- The in-app updater itself now actually works — it was pointing nowhere in v0.2.2. Update checks now run through a live server, so future updates will show up automatically here instead of needing a fresh manual install.
- Combined multi-month GSTR-2B preview: downloading several months now shows everything together in one preview grid instead of switching between separate tabs.
- Ledger pickers (Party Ledger, Journal/Expense ledger) are now searchable by typing instead of scrolling a long list.
- Row selection in the Preview Grid is more reliable, and locks automatically once a row is actually imported.
- Portal Download page now uses Financial Year (2025-26 style) instead of a plain calendar year.
- GSTR-2B Tally Import: missing-ledger rows can be fixed in place — pick an existing Tally ledger or create a new one with one click.
- New module: GSTR-1 Tally Import (Tally Suite) — upload GSTR-1 JSON, set Sales/CGST/SGST/IGST ledgers once, and post Sales entries straight into Tally.
